editorial: We didn't preserve a complete expense ledger for Greece, so there is no honest trip total to give you.

Athens surprised us on the cheaper side—EUR3 gyros and a EUR5 plate at Yiasemi were memorable examples—while Santorini predictably did the opposite. Location and accommodation on the island will swing your budget far more than food in Athens.

alternatives.title: What if we had a bigger budget?
editorial: Spend it on the Santorini stay. We would choose a nicer property closer to the caldera and town rather than upgrading anything in Athens.

alternatives.title: What if we had a smaller budget?
editorial: Keep Athens comfortable and inexpensive, then shorten or stay farther from the postcard-core in Santorini. Greece does not require fine dining to eat well.
